# Vendored typing-inspection

The sources and tests are from [typing-inspection](https://github.com/pydantic/typing-inspection)
tag `v0.4.2`, commit `8db011350942f33ac4b5d7db60d4d9ea83ab480f`.
The upstream MIT license is included. This copy is being adapted for Python
3.8 so the vendored MCP SDK can inspect tool and resource annotations.
